name: Snack Factory Makhana Popped Fox Nuts
ingredients: MAKHANA (POPPED GORGON NUT) (72%), REFINED PALMOLEIN OIL, SALT, SPICES & CONDIMENTS (FENNEL, CHILLI, FENUGREEK, CUMIN TURMERIC AND THYME) (1.8%), SUGAR, OLIVE OIL (1%) ACIDITY REGULATORS (INS 262 (i), INS 296, INS 330, IN 334), DRIED MANGO (AMCHUR) (0.5%), ANTICAKING AGENT (INS 551), THICKENER (INS 1450), STABILIZING AGENTS (INS 471, INS 433), MODIFIED STARCH (INS 1404) AND ADDED FLAVOUR (NATURE IDENTIC FLAVOURING SUBSTANCE - MANGO PICKLE).
